exposure: umbilical cord insertion type (peripheral, central, eccentric, marginal, velamentous)
cohort: The study included 220 pregnant women between 27 and 37 weeks gestation attending an antenatal clinic.
finding: Estimated fetal weight in the third trimester is greater in obese pregnant women with peripheral umbilical cord insertion, particularly between 31st and 34th weeks of gestation, with velamentous insertion showing the least EFW.
mod_finding: Peripheral umbilical cord insertion was significantly associated with a past history of cesarean section.
cross-section timing: During the third trimester of pregnancy (27 to 37 weeks gestation) over a 7-month period.
birth_weight: N/A (estimated fetal weight was measured, not birth weight)
